data.title: Select Harvests Lifts Annual Profit 29% on Record High Almond Volumes
data.description:
Select Harvests has lifted full-year net profit after tax by 29% to $39.3 million as stronger almond volumes outweighed the effects of an unusually wet and late harvest.

Reported EBIT increased 23% from $54.3m, with the stronger 38% underlying comparison excluding the previous year’s $5.8m water-sale gain.

The almond producer recorded earnings before interest and tax of $67m, a 38% increase against the previous year’s result excluding a one-off water-sale gain.

Its own crop rose 17% to 29,061 tonnes, while external grower deliveries almost doubled to 14,334t, lifting total processing volumes to a record 43,395t.

Net debt fell 17% to $65.4m and the board declared a fully franked final dividend of 4.5 cents per share, marking a return to shareholder distributions.

Challenging Wet Harvest

The company harvested 24,903t from its own orchards a year earlier, with improved horticultural performance supporting the latest increase despite difficult seasonal conditions.

At the Carina West Processing Facility, throughput increased 35% as additional grower supply flowed through a plant now capable of processing approximately 55,000t annually.

A new pre-cleaner and dryer handled more than 60,000t of wet field-weight crop, while the kernel recovery line and 24 new tree shakers helped protect saleable output.

Those investments came with additional costs, including about $14m of wet-harvest and other one-off expenses associated with drying, extended processing and fuel.

Average production costs were $7.61 per kilogram, compared with $7.82/kg in the previous year, although normalised costs on a 29,000t crop basis rose to $7.63/kg from $6.71/kg.

Stronger Almond Prices

The average almond pool price edged up to $10.26/kg from $10.18/kg, even as the wet harvest shifted more of the crop towards lower grades.

Value-added and other non-crop profit more than doubled to $15.1m, helped by the expanded contribution from third-party growers.

Operating cash flow declined to $94.4m from $118.6m as the delayed harvest pushed approximately 10,000t of crop into the new financial year, about half contracted by 30 September.

“We believe the almond cycle has changed,” managing director Kristina Hermanson said

“With around 80% of global supply now constrained and demand growing strongly in China and India, we believe the industry is in a structural upcycle—and Select Harvests is well positioned to benefit from these conditions with the right platform, in the right market, at the right time.”

Higher Throughput Target

Management is targeting 65,000t of annual throughput and return on capital employed above 12% by 2030, compared with 8.4% in 2026.

The proposed expansion relies substantially on external grower supply and partnership arrangements rather than a corresponding increase in company-owned orchard production.

Select Harvests has begun a sale process for its 600 hectares at Belvedere farm in New South Wales as part of its orchard portfolio review.

For 2027, the business plans further harvesting and processing investment, including 11 additional tree shakers and a second phase of kernel recovery improvements.

data.title: Chemtrade Reminds Unitholders to Vote at Special Meeting and Provides Supplemental Information
data.description:
TORONTO, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chemtrade Logistics Income Fund (TSX: CHE.UN; OTCQX®: CGIFF) (“Chemtrade” or the “Fund”) today reminds unitholders of the Fund (“Unitholders”) of its upcoming special meeting (the “Special Meeting”) and encourages Unitholders to vote FOR the previously announced proposed statutory plan of arrangement (the “Arrangement”) under the Business Corporations Act (Ontario) and the Trustee Act (Ontario) involving the Fund and Chemtrade Inc. (“New PubCo”), a newly incorporated corporation formed under the laws of the Province of Ontario, pursuant to which the Fund will convert from an income trust to a corporate structure.

The Special Meeting will be held at 10:00 a.m. (Eastern Standard Time) on December 7, 2026, at the offices of Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP, 100 King Street West, Suite 6300, Toronto, Ontario, M5X 1B8. At the Special Meeting, Unitholders will be asked to consider and approve: (i) the proposed conversion of the Fund from an income trust to a corporate structure pursuant to the Arrangement, and (ii) the adoption of a new deferred share unit plan (the “New PubCo DSU Plan”) by New PubCo.

Glass Lewis & Co., LLC (“Glass Lewis”), a leading independent proxy advisory firm, has issued a report recommending that Unitholders vote FOR the special resolution approving the Arrangement and the resolution approving the New PubCo DSU Plan at the upcoming Special Meeting.

The recommendation from Glass Lewis follows the unanimous recommendation by the board of trustees of the Fund that Unitholders vote FOR the Arrangement.

Unitholders are encouraged to review the full terms and conditions of the Arrangement and the Special Meeting and the factors considered by the trustees of the Fund, which are described in detail in the management information circular of the Fund dated November 6, 2026 (the “Circular”) and related documents which have been mailed to Unitholders and which have been filed with the Canadian securities regulatory authorities and made available under the Fund’s SEDAR+ profile at www.sedarplus.ca.

Supplemental Information

The following information is being provided by the Fund in advance of the Special Meeting to: (i) clarify expectations in relation to New PubCo’s authorized capital assuming the Arrangement is completed; and (ii) provide details regarding the proposed by-laws of New PubCo, in each case in response to a report issued by Institutional Shareholder Services Inc. (“ISS”). This information supplements, and is incorporated by reference into, the Circular. Capitalized terms used in this news release that are not defined have the meaning assigned to them in the Circular.

Description of New PubCo Share Capital

The Circular previously disclosed Chemtrade’s expectation that the authorized capital of New PubCo will consist of (i) an unlimited number of common shares, and (ii) preferred shares, issuable in series (“New PubCo Preferred Shares”).

The New PubCo Preferred Shares had initially been expected to be included in New PubCo’s authorized capital solely to provide the New PubCo Board with future financing flexibility. Neither the Fund nor New PubCo has any present intention or expectation that any New PubCo Preferred Shares will be issued. Nevertheless, in response to feedback received from ISS, the Fund has determined that New PubCo Preferred Shares will not form part of the authorized capital of New PubCo at the effective date of the Arrangement. Should the New PubCo Board determine in the future to amend the articles of New PubCo to create a class of preferred shares, issuable in series, any such amendment will be submitted to a meeting of the shareholders of New PubCo for approval.

Accordingly, immediately following completion of the Arrangement, the authorized capital of New PubCo will consist solely of an unlimited number of common shares. This mirrors the Fund’s current capital structure pursuant to its existing declaration of trust, under which Units are the only class of equity securities outstanding. Only common shares in the capital of New PubCo will be issued at the closing of the Arrangement.

The summary of the rights, privileges, restrictions and conditions expected to be attributed to the common shares of New PubCo has not changed from the description provided in the Circular. The summary will be subject to the articles of New PubCo as they will be in effect if the Arrangement is approved and effected.

Proposed New PubCo By-laws

As disclosed in the Circular, the corporate governance and mandates and policies of New PubCo are expected to be substantially similar to those of the Fund, modified as appropriate for a corporation and consistent with market practice. The Fund has today filed the Notice of Proposed Form of By-Laws of Chemtrade Inc., which includes the proposed form of by-laws of New PubCo and is available on the Fund’s website in the section titled “Investors” and has also been filed under the Fund’s SEDAR+ profile at www.sedarplus.ca. The proposed by-laws remain subject to approval by the New PubCo Board, subject to such further changes of a minor, housekeeping or clerical nature as may be approved by the New PubCo Board, and will become effective only if the Arrangement is approved at the Special Meeting.

If the Arrangement is completed, a copy of the articles and the by-laws of New PubCo will be posted on SEDAR+ and made available under a new profile of New PubCo, following the effective date of the Arrangement.

Reminder to Vote at the Special Meeting

Your vote is important, no matter how many trust units of the Fund (“Units”) you own. The Arrangement Resolution requires approval by at least 66 2/3% of the votes cast by Unitholders voting in person or by proxy at the Special Meeting. The New PubCo DSU Plan requires approval by a majority of the votes cast by Unitholders voting in person or by proxy at the Special Meeting. Only Unitholders of record as of the close of business on October 30, 2026 are entitled to receive notice of and vote at the Special Meeting.

Even if you plan to attend the Special Meeting, the Fund recommends that you vote your Units in advance of the proxy deadline of 10:00 a.m. (Eastern Standard Time) on December 3, 2026.

If you need assistance or have questions about how to vote your Units, please contact the Fund’s proxy solicitation agent, Carson Proxy Advisors, at 1-800-530-5189 (North American toll-free), 416-751-2066 (local/text) or by email at info@carsonproxy.com.

About Chemtrade

Chemtrade operates a diversified business providing industrial chemicals and services to customers in North and South America. Chemtrade is one of North America’s largest suppliers of sulphuric acid, spent acid processing services, inorganic coagulants for water treatment, sodium chlorate, sodium nitrite and sodium hydrosulphite. Chemtrade is also a leading producer of high purity sulphuric acid for the semiconductor industry in North America. Chemtrade is a leading regional supplier of sulphur, chlor-alkali products, and zinc oxide. Additionally, Chemtrade provides value-added water solutions, as well as industrial services such as processing by-products and waste streams.

data.title: AustralianSuper to back Brookfield's $2.53 billion bid for Reliance Worldwide, shares soar
data.description:
AustralianSuper, the country's largest pension fund, said on Tuesday it intends to back Brookfield's proposed $2.53 billion acquisition of Reliance Worldwide Corporation , sending the plumbing supplies firm's shares to a 20-month high.

  • Reliance Worldwide in September agreed to a scheme implementation deed under which Brookfield Capital Partners and its affiliates would acquire all of the Australian firm's shares for $3.38 apiece in cash, valuing the company at $2.53 billion

  • Reliance Worldwide's shares jumped nearly 12% to A$5.07, their highest level since mid-March 2025, while the broader market traded up 1.3% in early hours of the session

  • AustralianSuper held around 18.49% of Reliance Worldwide shares as at close of business on November 20, the superannuation fund said in a statement. It is the company's largest shareholder, according to LSEG data

  • AustralianSuper said it intends to vote in favour of Brookfield's buyout at Reliance Worldwide's scheme meeting next week in the absence of a superior proposal

  • Reliance Worldwide said last month that no rival bidder had emerged during the "go shop" process under the acquisition, prompting the board to reaffirm its unanimous recommendation for shareholders to back the deal

  • The firm and Brookfield had agreed to a "go shop" provision, unusual in Australian deals, that allowed Reliance Worldwide to seek rival bids, share due diligence materials and negotiate terms

data.title: Infragreen Lifts FY27 Underlying EBITDA Guidance After Strong First Four Months
data.description:
Infragreen Group has upgraded its full-year FY27 underlying EBITDA guidance to between $27 million and $29m, following a 25% lift in its look-through share of underlying EBITDA during the first four months of the financial year.

The company reported that its look-through share of underlying EBITDA after operating costs was $9.3m for the period from 1 July 2026 to 31 October 2026.

The updated guidance represents an increase on the guidance confirmed on 26 August 2026, and the company said the new range is 13% to 21% higher than FY26.

Underlying EBITDA is a non-statutory, look-through metric representing Infragreen’s share of EBITDA generated by each underlying business, less Infragreen’s expenses, on a comparable basis to the pro forma EBITDA in the prospectus lodged in June 2025.

Four-Business Portfolio

Operating momentum across the first four months of FY27 was supported by activity across each of Infragreen’s four core businesses:

  • Pure Environmental: Delivered growth on the prior corresponding period, supported by higher waste volumes across a broad range of customers, particularly in Queensland.
  • Minemet Recycling: Recorded growth over the prior corresponding period on consistent volumes, aided by stronger margins.
  • Energybuild: Delivered steady earnings compared with the second half of FY26, with the company stating it has not seen an impact from slowing new home construction and does not expect a significant impact in FY27.
  • Merredin Energy: Continued to post steady growth, with revenue linked to inflation remaining elevated.

Infragreen also noted that cash distributions from its portfolio strengthened over the four months to 31 October 2026, with $2.5m in dividends received from underlying businesses.

This is an increase of $0.6m, or 32%, on the same period a year earlier.

Infrastructure Platform

Infragreen owns, operates, and grows mid-market infrastructure businesses across Australia and New Zealand.

The company says its businesses focus on recycling and waste recovery alongside clean energy and energy transition, and that it targets established operators that have historically had limited access to long-term capital.

In its November 2026 update, the board said it remains focused on scaling existing businesses, considering asset realisations, and expanding the platform where opportunities arise.

data.title: XCF Global Advances Renewable Fuels Growth Strategy and Plans OTC Transition Following Nasdaq Delisting Notice
data.description:
Reno production growth and 127% increase in third-quarter revenue support continued focus on commercial execution and expansion

HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / November 23, 2026 / XCF Global, Inc. ("XCF" or the "Company"), a U.S.-based producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, today outlined its continued focus on growing renewable fuel production, strengthening commercial performance and advancing its expansion strategy as it prepares for a planned transition to over-the-counter trading. On November 18, 2026, the Company received a notice from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") determining to delist XCF's Class A common stock from The Nasdaq Capital Market.

"We are building on tangible progress at Reno, where production increased each month during the third quarter and revenue grew 127% year over year," said Chris Cooper, XCF Global Chief Executive Officer. "With Southern Energy and DevvStream Corp. now part of XCF and a definitive agreement signed for the proposed Paramount acquisition, we have expanded our capabilities and established opportunities for future growth. Our priority is to convert that progress into consistent production, stronger customer relationships and improved cash generation. We remain confident in the opportunity to build a significant domestic renewable fuels business that supports American agriculture and energy security, and we are committed to earning shareholder confidence through execution and results."

XCF's operating progress provides a foundation for its next phase of development. Following the July restart at New Rise Renewables Reno, monthly renewable diesel production increased from approximately 0.55 million gallons in July to 1.01 million gallons in August and 1.35 million gallons in September. Commercial shipments increased 15.5% from August to September to 1.46 million gallons, and third-quarter 2026 revenue increased 127% year over year to $21.7 million.

In October, XCF completed its business combination with Southern Energy Renewables Inc. and DevvStream Corp., broadening its renewable fuel technology capabilities and adding expertise in environmental asset management and monetization. The Company also signed a definitive agreement to acquire the Paramount, California renewable fuel refinery. The proposed acquisition remains subject to closing conditions, financing and other requirements.

Building on these developments, XCF is focused on improving production consistency and commercial performance at Reno, advancing planning for Paramount and evaluating additional renewable fuel development opportunities. The Company's strategy centers on expanding U.S. renewable fuel production, creating additional markets for domestic agricultural feedstocks and building long-term shareholder value.

On November 16, 2026, the Company filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. XCF intends to continue providing shareholders with updates on its financial performance, operating progress and strategic initiatives through SEC filings and public announcements.

The Staff's determination was triggered by the Company's Class A common stock having a closing bid price of $0.10 or less for ten consecutive trading days, from November 4, 2026, through November 17, 2026. Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A)(iii), if a company's security has a closing bid price of $0.10 or less for ten consecutive trading days during a compliance period for the minimum bid price requirement, the Staff is required to issue a delisting determination, regardless of any time remaining in that compliance period.

At the time of the determination, XCF was in a compliance period under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), which requires listed securities to maintain a minimum bid price of $1.00 per share (the "Minimum Bid Price Requirement"). As previously disclosed, Nasdaq notified the Company on December 9, 2025, that its Class A common stock had closed below $1.00 per share for 30 consecutive business days. The Company received an initial 180-calendar-day compliance period through June 8, 2026, and, on June 9, 2026, an additional 180-calendar-day period through December 7, 2026. The Company has not regained compliance with the Minimum Bid Price Requirement.

According to the notice, trading in the Company's Class A common stock on Nasdaq will be suspended at the opening of business on November 25, 2026. Nasdaq will file a Form 25-NSE with the Securities and Exchange Commission to remove the Company's securities from listing and registration on Nasdaq.

Under the Nasdaq Listing Rule 5800 Series, the Company may request a hearing before a Nasdaq Hearings Panel to appeal the Staff's determination by 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 25, 2026. A timely hearing request would not stay the suspension of trading in the Company's Class A common stock. The Company does not intend to request a hearing.

Following the delisting from Nasdaq, it is expected that Company's common stock will initially trade on the Pink Limited Market operated by OTC Market, under the same trading symbol "SAFX". However, the Company is working to facilitate quotation of its common stock on the over-the-counter market following the Nasdaq suspension and intends to pursue the highest OTC market tier for which it qualifies, which we expect will be OTCID. The timing of OTC quotation, applicable market tier and trading symbol will be announced when confirmed. There can be no assurance regarding the timing or availability of OTC quotation or qualification for any particular market tier.

About XCF Global, Inc.

XCF Global, Inc. ("XCF") is a U.S.-based renewable energy company focused on fueling the future by accelerating the production and deployment of cleaner fuels utilizing agricultural and other waste products. Following its recent combinations with Southern Energy Renewables and DevvStream Corp., XCF is building a vertically integrated platform across the clean fuel sector, employing today's commercially scalable technologies, future lower cost-reduced carbon technologies and environmental asset management and monetization. The Company's flagship facility, New Rise Renewables Reno, produces renewable diesel, sustainable aviation fuel and renewable Naptha, and has a permitted nameplate production capacity of up to 40 million gallons per year. XCF is also seeking to complete the acquisition of the recently announced Paramount, a California renewable fuel production facility as well as advance a pipeline of potential expansion opportunities in Nevada, North Carolina, Florida, Louisiana and elsewhere, and build relationships across the energy and transportation sectors that it believes could support the scaling of clean fuel production. For more information, visit www.xcf.global.

data.title: Grown Rogue Signs Definitive Agreements for Planned Acquisition of the Licenses and Select Assets of PharmaCann New York
data.description:
MEDFORD, Ore., Nov. 23, 2026 /CNW/ -- Grown Rogue International Inc. ("Grown Rogue" or the "Company") () (), a flower-forward cannabis company combining craft values with disciplined execution, today announced that on November 23, 2026, Grown Rogue New York, LLC ("GRNY"), its 51%-owned subsidiary, signed two definitive agreements – a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement ("MIPA") and an Asset Purchase Agreement ("APA") –  in connection with the planned acquisition of the licenses and majority of the assets of PharmaCann of New York, LLC ("PCNY") and select assets of PharmaCann Inc.

Execution of the definitive agreements marks a key milestone in the transaction first announced in August 2026. Completion of the acquisitions remains subject to required New York regulatory approvals and other closing conditions.

The planned acquisition encompasses the majority of PCNY's licensed business and related assets, including the Hamptonburgh cultivation and manufacturing facility and four Verilife dispensaries. Total cash consideration under the purchase agreements is $3.0 million, which excludes approximately $1.5 million previously paid to PharmaCann Inc. to facilitate the use of PCNY's working capital upon the initial transaction announcement in August.

As previously announced, GRNY's capital partner invested $10 million for a 49% preferred equity interest and committed up to an additional $5 million through a drawable term loan. All dollar amounts are in U.S. dollars.

The next step is for PCNY to submit a change-of-control application to New York's Office of Cannabis Management ("OCM"). Under the Goods and Services Agreement ("GSA") executed on August 20, 2026, GRNY began supporting PCNY's operating transition, including the restart of cultivation at Hamptonburgh. GRNY has also begun the True Party of Interest regulatory disclosure process with OCM.

"We're growers first, so for me, the best part of all this is seeing plants growing again at Hamptonburgh," said Obie Strickler, Chief Executive Officer of Grown Rogue. "After spending a few days on site last week, I couldn't be more excited about how the team is getting the facility stabilized and repopulated. All 15 indoor flower rooms are loaded, and the first harvest is scheduled for mid-December. We brought in some of our own genetics as well as some regionally curated genetics based on input from the local team. With two harvests per week, we should be ramping up to producing more than 400 pounds of high-quality flower per week. I'm especially proud of how quickly the team has come together. It's been great to watch our existing team work alongside our new hires in New York and the PCNY team, who are excited to be back on site and working. Walking the rooms and halls and seeing the smiles, passion and excitement, I know we're well on our way to bringing the quality flower Grown Rogue is known for to New York."

"There's been a lot to get done in a short time, and I appreciate how closely PharmaCann has worked with us to keep things moving and protect local jobs. GRNY and the landlord have both put a lot of time and capital into getting Hamptonburgh back up and running, and OCM has been responsive along the way. That matters to the people who work there and to the patients and customers who count on a steady supply of cannabis."

"As we discussed with our third-quarter results, the New York transaction represents a significant new project for our finance and accounting team as we close out the year and prepare for our 2026 audit," said Andrew Marchington, Chief Financial Officer of Grown Rogue. "Subject to completing our accounting assessment, we expect to consolidate PCNY's results from the date the purchase agreements were signed. We're working to make sure our auditors have the records they need. Staff departures and liquidity constraints at PCNY's parent could limit how much support they're able to provide, so we're adding to our finance and support teams and working to retain critical staff at PCNY."

About Grown Rogue

Grown Rogue International Inc. ( | ) is a flower-forward cannabis company rooted in Oregon's Rogue Valley, a region with a deep cannabis heritage where its founders began growing more than 20 years ago. Built on a love of the plant, the Company produces flavorful craft-quality flower and the products made from it.

Its approach brings together a distinct and constantly expanding library of genetics, developed in house and sourced from like-minded breeders; a passionate, experienced team of growers; and the discipline to keep learning from every harvest. data.title: The newest addition to the S&P 500 is a maker of viral ice-cream machines
data.description:
By Claudia Assis

SharkNinja will join the S&P 500, replacing AES

SharkNinja will be replacing a utility and power company in the benchmark index.

SharkNinja, maker of several small-appliance products that have gone viral in recent years, such as the Ninja Creami ice-cream maker and the Ninja Crispi air fryer, is joining the S&P 500 index.

The latest move from S&P Dow Jones Indices, announced Monday, is a departure from recent inclusions, which have tended to favor tech companies. The consumer-products brand will replace utility and power generator AES (AES) on Dec. 2, the index provider said. A consortium is buying AES in a deal expected to close soon.

Shares of SharkNinja (SN) rose nearly 2% in the after-hours session Monday after ending the regular trading day up 6%. The company went public in 2023.

Recent S&P 500 SPX shake-ups included the inclusion of Twilio (TWLO) in October, as well as the addition of chip maker Marvell Technology (MRVL) and electronics manufacturer Flex (FLEX) earlier this year. The index also added Ferguson (FERG), a wholesale distributor of plumbing, heating and other products for construction trades, in July.

A spot in the S&P 500 is a coveted place for companies, as it brings their shares to a much broader range of investors, including passive funds that track indexes and actively managed funds that may have limitations on where they can invest.

More S&P 500 changes could be announced next Friday as the index committee conducts its quarterly rebalancing.

-Claudia Assis

data.title: BridgeBio gains approval of Welgemda for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy
data.description:
Key points:
  • The US FDA has approved BridgeBio Pharma's Welgemda (ribitol), the first-ever treatment for any type of limb-girdle muscular dystrophy.
  • Approval was based on data from the phase FORTIFY trial of individuals with limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2I/R9 (LGMD2I/R9). In that study, On the 100-meter timed test, a measure of ambulatory ability, patients given Welgemda showed a 0.27 m/s benefit in velocity relative to placebo at a 12-month interim analysis. Also, forced vital capacity, a measure of pulmonary function, improved approximately 3% from baseline in individuals treated with Welgemda and declined approximately 2% in the placebo cohort.
  • BridgeBio also received a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher with the approval.
  • About 2,000 to 3,000 individuals in the US have the condition.

data.title: US Medicare says price cuts on 13 more drugs will reduce spending by 45%
data.description:
By Deena Beasley

The US Medicare health plan on Monday said new, lower prices for 13 of its costliest drugs, including Gilead's HIV treatment Biktarvy and Eli Lilly's diabetes drug Trulicity, will cut costs by 45% compared with recent annual spending on those medicines, or about $9.2 billion.

The price reductions, which take effect in 2028, are the third annual round of negotiated cuts under the former Biden administration's Inflation Reduction Act of 2022. Medicare, the federal health plan covering over 67 million people aged 65 and over, was previously barred by law from negotiating prices with drugmakers.

"The Trump administration is committed to use every tool at our disposal to negotiate fairer, more affordable prices to ease the burden on Medicare beneficiaries," Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Administrator Mehmet Oz said in a statement.

The agency said its monthly price for Biktarvy will be cut by 37%, while Trulicity will be 84% lower. Overall, the price reductions range from 34% to 84%.

Gilead warned last month that Medicare's new "maximum fair price" of $2,600 for a month's supply of Biktarvy would reduce sales of the drug by about $1.5 billion, although the drugmaker still expects overall HIV revenue to increase compared to 2027.

Medicare said two drugs previously selected for negotiation, Pfizer's arthritis treatment Xeljanz and Roche's asthma drug Xolair, were exempted from the program because they already have generic competition.

The agency also said AbbVie's Botox will not be subject to a maximum fair price due to a court order.

Despite the pharmaceutical industry's longstanding opposition to the law and multiple failed lawsuits, the first negotiated prices on 10 drugs sold in pharmacies went into effect this year.

The 2028 list also includes products that are administered in doctors' offices or hospitals, such as Novartis' psoriasis drug Cosentyx and Takeda's Entyvio for Crohn's disease. Novartis' breast cancer drug Kisqali and antidepressant Rexulti, sold by Otsuka Pharmaceutical and Lundbeck , are also among the 13 medicines with lower Medicare prices.

Medicare said the selected drugs accounted for $22.3 billion in spending in 2025. The drugs are also selected based on being either 7 or 11 years out from being approved by the US Food and Drug Administration and for which there is no generic or biosimilar alternative.

Medicare said last year that the prices it had negotiated for 15 drugs starting in 2027, including Novo Nordisk's GLP-1 drug Ozempic, would save the program 36% on those medications compared with recent annual spending, or about $8.5 billion.

data.title: Swire Pacific to Trim Cathay Pacific Stake in $458M Deal
data.description:
By P.R. Venkat

Hong Kong conglomerate Swire Pacific is further reducing its stake in Cathay Pacific Airways in a share sale to raise about US$458 million.

The conglomerate plans to sell 252.66 million Cathay Pacific shares through a share placement, Swire said late Monday.

Each share will be placed at 14.23 Hong Kong dollars, equivalent to US$1.81. The price represents an 8.5% discount to the airline's last closing price of HK$15.55.

Proceeds from the placement will be used to meet working capital needs. The company also expects to book a gain of about HK$870 million from the sale.

After the sale, Swire's stake in Cathay will fall to 35%. In September, Swire had sold Cathay shares to partly fund a US$653 million bond repurchase, cutting its stake to 39.15%.

"The company intends to retain a significant long-term strategic shareholding in Cathay Pacific Airways and does not intend to further reduce its shareholding level," Swire Pacific said.

It also agreed not to sell more Cathay shares for 12 months after the deal closes.

J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and HSBC are acting as placing agents.

data.title: Scalare Partners Portfolio Company MyPass Powers Contractor Compliance for BHP, Shell and Woodside
data.description:
Sydney, Australia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 23, 2026) - Scalare Partners Holdings Limited ("Scalare") highlights the progress of portfolio company MyPass Global ("MyPass"), the workforce credentials platform trusted by some of the world's largest resources and energy companies, and one of the clearest examples of Scalare's early-stage investment model at work.

From seed investment to global platform

Scalare invested in MyPass's seed round in 2020, backing co-founder Matt Smith and his team at an early stage. Since then, MyPass has grown into a global platform that digitises worker credentials, training records and site access, helping employers onboard contractors faster, cut compliance costs and keep workers safe.

Today, more than 1,600 companies use MyPass to manage their workforce worldwide. Customers include BHP, Shell, Woodside, UGL & Downer. BHP uses MyPass to power its global contractor system and worker Skills Passport, creating an enterprise-wide record of its contractor workforce.

Backed for global growth

In January 2025, MyPass raised a A$7.5 million Series A led by Sydney venture capital firm OneVentures, to extend their market-leading position in Australia, and to expand into the Americas. Since that time they've secured Santos and Incitec Pivot locally, whilst expanding with Woodside into Mexico, BHP into Peru and Wood into the USA.

MyPass continues to extend into new sectors where workforce compliance is critical, including energy, construction and utilities. Their market leading position has been reinforced by their industry-level partnerships with the Clean Energy Council and Powering Skills Organisation, whose members utilise the Skills Passport to ensure their sectors have a job-ready workforce, now and into the future.

More than capital

Scalare's model combines early investment with hands-on support. Scalare co-founding partner Nick Roberts has supported MyPass as a director and investor since 2018, contributing strategic guidance, networks and governance experience from building and exiting his own technology businesses, including compliance software company Complinet, which was acquired by Thomson Reuters.

"MyPass shows what happens when great founders get the right support early. Matt and the team have consistently hit their milestones and it's been a privilege to back them from seed through to global scale and growing market leadership," said Nick Roberts, Co-Founding Partner, Scalare Partners.

A maturing portfolio

MyPass is one of nine Scalare portfolio companies in the Scaling and Globalisation stage. As at 30 June 2026, Scalare's portfolio of 25 companies across five countries was valued at A$12.5 million against A$5.7 million invested, with 16 companies in the Revenue Momentum or Scaling and Globalisation stages.

"Our ecosystem gives us a front-row seat to the best founders in Australia, often years before other investors meet them. MyPass is a great example of what that access, combined with real operational support, can deliver," said Carolyn Breeze, CEO, Scalare Partners.

About Golden Rapture Mining

Golden Rapture Mining Corporation is a Canadian exploration-stage company engaged in the acquisition, exploration and development of high-potential mineral properties in Ontario. The Company's portfolio of properties includes the Phillips Township, Swell Bay, Bully Boy, South of Goliath, Northern Queen and the Hutchison Mine project.
